text: The last team to win three NBA titles in a row? The Los Angeles Lakers. 2000. 2001. 2002. Shaq and Kobe. Three straight rings. In 2001, they went 15 and 1 in the playoffs. One loss — the whole postseason. Since then? 24 years… and nobody has done it again. Now, for the first time since 2018, there's no LeBron in LA. This is Luka's team. And it's WORKING. 14 and 3. First in the West. Luka is dropping 37 a night. Austin Reaves is back. Walker Kessler is owning the paint. But the road is brutal. Wemby's Spurs — the title favorites. The Knicks — the defending champs. And LeBron, now in Philly, standing in the way. Plus their own problems: thin at forward, and no real backup center. Vegas? About 25 to 1. So… can Luka start the next Lakers dynasty? One ring. Then two. Then three. Drop your pick in the comments.
